hazards.hazard: Wrong tote selected and charged due to hand-labelled totes and manual paper batch sheet — incorrect stoichiometry triggers runaway hydrosilylation or hydrogen evolution, overpressurising mixing tank
equipment: portable air-operated diaphragm pump and hoses
hazards.reason: Package states totes are 'labelled by hand' and operator 'reads the paper batch sheet, collects the listed tote … connects the hose and pumps the contents'. No barcode, scale, or independent check. A single mis-read or mis-pick puts catalyst with Si–H fluid in wrong ratio, or KOH emulsifier with Si–

hazards.hazard: Uncontrolled hydrosilylation (methylhydrogen siloxane + platinum catalyst) from wrong addition order, ratio, or agitator failure — rapid exotherm overheats batch, tank overpressures through loose lid/manway
equipment: portable air-operated diaphragm pump and hoses
jacket temperature control with a high-temperature alarm
hazards.reason: Reaction is intended but highly exothermic. Safeguards: only jacket high-temperature alarm (operator must react). No emergency quench, no pressure relief device, no agitator stall detection. Loose lid is not sized for emergency venting.

hazards.hazard: Hydrogen gas from Si–H hydrolysis (methylhydrogen siloxane + KOH emulsifier + water) accumulates in building — unclassified electrical equipment ignites flash fire/explosion
hazards.reason: KOH catalyses Si–H hydrolysis to H2. Water comes from DI water charge or humidity. Gas vents through loose lid/manway into 2000 m² building with only general exhaust fans and 'unclassified, general-purpose equipment throughout'. No H2 detection, no inerting, no classified electrical.

hazards.hazard: Isopropyl alcohol vapours displaced during charging fill building — static spark from unclassified equipment ignites vapour cloud
equipment: portable air-operated diaphragm pump and hoses
hazards.reason: IPA is charged via open manway; vapours escape. Building has only general exhaust fans and unclassified electrical. No vapour recovery, no inerting, no LEL monitoring. Likelihood high every batch that uses IPA.

hazards.hazard: Portable pump/hose cross-contamination — catalyst residue in hose contacts next batch's Si–H fluid causing reaction in hose or tank
equipment: portable air-operated diaphragm pump and hoses
hazards.reason: Single pump/hose set used for all totes. Package describes no cleaning, flushing, or dedicate‑hose procedure. Catalyst trace in hose meets Si–H fluid on next charge → immediate hydrosilylation in hose (blockage, rupture) or tank (runaway).

hazards.hazard: Jacket temperature control fails open — batch overheats, exothermic reaction accelerates, tank overpressures before operator responds to high-temperature alarm
equipment: jacket temperature control with a high-temperature alarm
hazards.reason: Only safeguard is high-temperature alarm. No automatic steam/cooling water shut-off, no emergency dump/quench. Alarm relies on operator presence and speed; building is 2000 m², operator may be at warehouse.

hazards.hazard: Agitator failure during reaction — poor mixing creates hot spots, local runaway reaction, tank overpressure
hazards.reason: Agitators have no stall/torque monitoring, no interlock with jacket heating. If agitator stops, exothermic reaction stratifies; hot spot drives thermal runaway. Loose lid not designed for emergency relief.

hazards.hazard: Overfilling mixing tank during charging — chemical spills through manway, operator exposure, environmental release
equipment: portable air-operated diaphragm pump and hoses
hazards.reason: No level instrument, no high-level alarm, no automatic pump stop. Operator watches manway and stops pump manually. Paper batch sheet gives no real-time quantity feedback. Spill likely on over-pump or wrong tote volume.

hazards.hazard: Acetic acid charged into KOH emulsifier (or vice versa) too fast — violent neutralisation heat and splashing corrosive liquid onto operator at manway
equipment: portable air-operated diaphragm pump and hoses
hazards.reason: Both charged via same pump/hose through manway. No addition-rate control, no sequence interlock. Operator at manway connecting hose. PPE (gloves, goggles, apron) limited against splash.

hazards.hazard: Vinyl-functional silicone polymer + platinum catalyst charged without sufficient Si–H fluid — catalyst remains active, later Si–H addition causes delayed runaway
equipment: portable air-operated diaphragm pump and hoses
hazards.reason: Catalyst activates vinyl groups; reaction normally consumes Si–H. If Si–H short-charged (wrong tote, pump error), unreacted catalyst/vinyl stays. Later Si–H addition (next batch or top-up) triggers unexpected exotherm. No catalyst deactivation step, no composition verification.
